what: Payment is typically issued in 1-3 business days from the time your items have been verified. / Orders are currently being verified and paid 3-7 business days after receipt.
reward: Payment is typically issued in 1-3 business days from the time your items have been verified. / Orders are currently being verified and paid 3-7 business days after receipt.
requirements: Anyone who owns at least $1,000 of gold/silver/platinum/palladium bullion, coins, jewelry, or scrap and can ship it insured.
payout_timing: Price locked online instantly; ship; verified and paid 3-7 business days after receipt per current FAQ (typically 1-3 business days after verification).
payout_value_note: Minimum $1,000 sale; actual payout is the locked buy-back price for your specific products at current spot - varies with weight, purity, and market price.
catches: Minimum sell amount is $1,000 - smaller holdings don't qualify.
Price lock is time-sensitive; if your metals arrive late or the market moves against the lock terms, sale terms can be affected - ship promptly.
Wire costs $25, mailed check costs $30 and takes 7-14 days; ACH is free and 2-3 business days - pick ACH.
Jewelry/scrap paid at minimum 80% of melt (gold/platinum/palladium) or 65% (sterling silver) - below full melt value.
You must already own bullion/coins - this is liquidation of an asset, not earnings from nothing.

steps.text: Go to jmbullion.com/sell-to-us/ and use the Sell To Us tool to select products, input quantity, and lock in your price online 24/7 (or call/email).
Receive mailing instructions by email; ship via insured mail following them exactly (they provide UPS labels for the DIY tool).
Their inventory team inspects and approves each item after receipt.
Payment issued after approval: ACH/direct deposit free (2-3 business days), wire transfer $25 fee (same day), or check by mail ($30 fee, 7-14 days delivery).
Note: their FAQ currently states orders are being verified and paid 3-7 business days after receipt - still within the fast window.

who_pays: JM Bullion, a bullion dealer that resells the metals and products it buys back.
who_qualifies: A human who already owns physical precious metals worth $1,000+ and can ship them insured - the buyer needs your actual metal; AI cannot own or ship bullion.
work_available: Always available - 24/7 DIY Sell To Us price-lock tool.
what_gets_accepted: Gold/silver/platinum/palladium bullion products listed in their tool, plus jewelry, scrap, and silverware (paid at min 80%/65% of melt); items must arrive as described and pass inspection.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No seller fees; insured shipping provided; optional $25 wire or $30 check fee; ~20-45 min active.
when_cash_arrives: Payment issued 1-3 business days after verification (currently 3-7 business days after receipt): ACH 2-3 business days free, wire same-day ($25 fee), check 7-14 days by mail ($30 fee).

repeatable.cadence: once per metals holding you liquidate

demand_side: The venue is jmbullion.com/sell-to-us itself (the buyer). Demand side = JM Bullion's bullion dealership, which republishes buy-back prices continuously. The DIY Sell To Us tool shows live buy prices per product - you lock a price online 24/7 without calling anyone. You reach it today at jmbullion.com/sell-to-us/ (account required to check out the sale). You get 'picked' by locking a price; they email shipping instructions and pay after inspection.

what: Get a real offer in minutes, valid for seven days; after we verify your vehicle, you are paid on the spot.
reward: Get a real offer in minutes, valid for seven days; after we verify your vehicle, you are paid on the spot.
requirements: Must own the vehicle (title); valid ID; vehicle must be brought in for verification.
payout_timing: Offer in minutes, valid seven days; paid on the spot after vehicle verification.
catches: The in-person verification can change the offer if the vehicle's condition differs from what you entered.
The offer expires after seven days; market moves can lower a refreshed offer.
Pickup or transport fees can apply in some cases and reduce proceeds.
You need the title/ownership documents and the vehicle present for verification.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

steps.text: Enter your VIN/license and vehicle details online for an offer in minutes
Offer valid seven days - schedule verification at a CarMax store
CarMax verifies the vehicle in person
Get paid on the spot after verification (discrepancies can change the offer)

who_pays: CarMax - the company pays you directly for your vehicle.
who_qualifies: You must own the vehicle (have the title), have valid ID, and bring the vehicle in for verification.
work_available: Yes - CarMax was buying vehicles as of 2026-09-23. You get a real online offer in minutes, but it expires after seven days.
what_gets_accepted: The online offer is not final: in-person verification can cut it if the car does not match your description. Clean the car and fix cheap cosmetic flaws before the appointment.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Pickup or transport fees can apply in some cases. Your unpaid time is entering the details online, driving to the store, and waiting through verification.
when_cash_arrives: Real money - paid on the spot after the vehicle passes in-person verification. Get competing quotes from Carvana and AutoNation the same week and take the highest.

repeatable.cadence: You can only sell each vehicle once - this is a one-time payout per car, not recurring income.

what: Earn 85% of the selling price when you consign a fine watch with a list price of $2,500 or more. Earn 80% of the selling price when you consign a handbag with a list price of $5,000 or more. Earn 70% of the selling price when you consign a handbag with a list price from $1,000 to $4,999 or any fine
reward: Earn 85% of the selling price when you consign a fine watch with a list price of $2,500 or more. Earn 80% of the selling price when you consign a handbag with a list price of $5,000 or more. Earn 70% of the selling price when you consign a handbag with a list price from $1,000 to $4,999 or any fine jewelry item with a list price of $1,000 or more.
requirements: Anyone 18+ who owns authentic luxury items
catches: Tiered by RealReal Rewards: commission rate based on net sales in your one-year commission window; per the official SEC S-1, rates range 55% (under $1,500 net sales) to 70% ($10,000+ net sales).
Item commission rates (per RealReal's own promotional terms): fine watches $2,500+ earn 85%; handbags $5,000+ earn 80%; handbags $1,000–$4,999 and fine jewelry $1,000+ earn 70%.
Item-level rates go as low as 40% for items with an original resale list price of $145 or less (per official SEC S-1).
Get Paid Now = upfront payment but lower than consignment; site credit pays +5% extra.
The RealReal takes physical possession, authenticates, photographs, and lists for you — zero seller effort, but you cede all pricing control.
Rates can change at any time at their discretion (promotional terms say so explicitly).

steps.text: Schedule pickup, ship, drop off, or video appointment with a Luxury Manager
The RealReal authenticates, photographs, prices, and lists your items
Get paid by check, direct deposit, or site credit (+5%)

who_pays: The RealReal pays you — consignment earnings after your item sells, Get Paid Now upfront payment, or site credit (which pays +5% extra).
who_qualifies: Anyone 18+ who owns authentic luxury items.
work_available: The RealReal's consignment program is active — they take physical possession, authenticate, photograph, and list for you.
what_gets_accepted: Items must be authentic luxury goods; The RealReal authenticates, photographs, and lists for you — zero seller effort, but you cede all pricing control. Commission tiers: you keep 55% of the sale price under $1,500 in one-year net sales up to 70% at $10,000+; item-level rates include 85% on fine watches $2,500+, 80% on handbags $5,000+, 70% on handbags $1,000–$4,999 and fine jewelry $1,000+, and as low as 40% on items with a resale list price of $145 or less. Rates can change at their discretion.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No listing fees — the commission is the cost: The RealReal keeps 30–45% of the sale price depending on your tier (you keep the rest). Get Paid Now takes an additional discount for upfront cash. Unpaid time is minimal: shipping your item to them; they do everything else.
when_cash_arrives: After your item sells plus the buyer's return window passes — via check, direct deposit, or site credit (+5% extra).

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable per item — consign again every time you have authentic luxury goods to sell.

requirements: Referrer: existing Kalshi user in good standing who has transacted at least $25 on Predictions. Referee: new Kalshi user, US person, completes KYC, transacts at least $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening; max 40 referrals per user; referral link OR promo code, not both

Same lottery odds as the promo code program: 70% of participants get just $15, and receipt of any tier is not guaranteed.
Both sides must independently qualify - if your friend fails KYC or doesn't trade $25 within 7 days, neither of you gets anything.
Bonus credit expires 7 days after grant.
Gambling problem help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

steps.text: As an existing Kalshi user, transact at least $25 on Predictions to unlock your referral link
Send your personal referral link to a friend
Friend signs up via the link, completes KYC, and transacts $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening
Both you and your friend each receive a variable bonus credit ($15-$500)
Trade the credit within 7 days; withdraw only profits

who_pays: Kalshi pays both sides' bonus credit out of its own promo budget.
who_qualifies: Referrer: an existing Kalshi user in good standing who has already transacted at least $25 on Predictions. Friend: a new Kalshi user, US person, who completes identity verification (KYC) and transacts $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening. Max 40 referrals per user; one account per person; referral link OR promo code, not both. Minimum age and exact state availability: unverified.
what_gets_accepted: Your friend signs up via your referral link, finishes KYC, and trades $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening. Both you and your friend then each independently receive a variable bonus credit ($15-$500 per the official tier table).
costs_and_unpaid_time: No cash cost to you. Your friend must put up $25 of their own trading activity, which can lose 100%. Your unpaid time: ~10-20 minutes per friend to send the link and help them through KYC and the qualifying trade.
when_cash_arrives: Nothing arrives as cash. Credit posts after your friend qualifies, expires 7 days after grant, is non-withdrawable, and only profits from trading the credit can ever be withdrawn.

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per referred friend, up to 40 referrals per user; each friend's bonus is one-time
